name: Cyclic CA Spirals
desc: A Greenberg-Hastings cyclic cellular automaton that self-organizes from noise into rotating rainbow pinwheels and demon-eye target waves tiling the whole frame, rendered as full-hue pinwheels, warm ember, cool ocean, two-ink duotone, green phosphor CRT, or bright wavefront contours.

scale.doc: cell size / grid coarseness (higher = chunkier cells, fewer columns)

density.doc: reseed cadence + spiral spawning richness (higher = more nucleation)

speed.doc: generations advanced per second (wave rotation rate)

states.doc: number of color states N (cycle length / spiral-arm thickness)

hue.doc: base hue offset rotating the color wheel

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100 = opaque bg)
